metadata.methodology: FIFO Fund Allocation & Decoupled Evidence Engine

bias_neutralization_audit.interpretation: The model demonstrates strong alignment with structural intensity metrics (r=0.92) rather than raw file size. Accounts with multi-day dwell times (e.g. Michael Mammen) are properly de-prioritized despite high debits.
